SECTION 1

Introduction

Welcome to WordRace.io ("the Platform", "we", "us", "our"). WordRace.io is a competitive online vocabulary game inspired by the classic Petit Bac format, where players race to fill categories starting with a given letter.

These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Platform, including all game modes, features, virtual currency, and future Play-to-Earn (P2E) functionality. Please read them carefully.

By accessing or using WordRace.io, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Platform.

SECTION 2

Eligibility

To use WordRace.io you must:

  • Be at least 13 years old. Users under 18 must have parental or guardian consent.
  • Provide accurate information when creating an account.
  • Not be prohibited from using the Platform under applicable laws.

By using the Platform, you represent that you meet all eligibility requirements. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that do not comply.

SECTION 3

User Accounts

Beta Phase

WordRace.io is currently in public beta. During this phase, user accounts and game data are stored locally in your browser (localStorage). This means:

  • Your account data is not synced across devices or browsers.
  • Clearing your browser data will permanently delete your account.
  • Persistent server-side accounts will be introduced at the official P2E launch.

Account Security

You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your username and any credentials. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account via the Support page.

Account Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any account that violates these Terms, without prior notice.

SECTION 4

Game Rules & Modes

WordRace.io offers the following game modes:

  • 🆓 Casual Training — Free mode. Play against AI bots, friends, or random players. No entry fee.
  • ⚔️ Duel Arena — Competitive 1v1 duels with real USDT wagers. Coming in Q3 2026.
  • 📅 Daily League — Daily tournament with prize pool redistribution. Coming in Q3 2026.

Core Rules

  • Players must type words starting with the letter shown for each category.
  • Words are validated by the platform's dictionary and category-specific systems.
  • Each valid word scores 10 points. Empty or invalid words score 0.
  • The game lasts 40 seconds per round.
  • Copy/paste and tab-switching are prohibited and trigger automatic forfeit.
SECTION 5

Fair Play & Anti-Cheat

We are committed to maintaining a fair competitive environment. The following are strictly prohibited:

  • Using bots, scripts, or automation tools.
  • Exploiting bugs or vulnerabilities for an unfair advantage.
  • Collusion with other players.
  • Sharing accounts or multiple account abuse.
  • Attempting to manipulate rankings or prize distribution.

Violations may result in immediate account suspension, forfeiture of winnings, and permanent ban. We use automated and manual detection systems.

SECTION 6

WRC Credits & Virtual Currency

WRC Credits ("WRC") are the Platform's virtual in-game currency. Key terms:

  • 1 WRC = $0.01 USD (reference value).
  • WRC can be used to purchase power-ups (💡 Hint = 5 WRC, ❄️ Freeze = 10 WRC) and enter paid game modes.
  • During the beta phase, WRC transactions are simulated and have no real monetary value.
  • WRC Credits are non-transferable and cannot be converted to cash during beta.
  • We reserve the right to modify WRC values, pricing, and usage rules at any time.
SECTION 7

Play-to-Earn (P2E) Features

WordRace.io intends to launch P2E features in Q3 2026, including real USDT wagers and prize pool distributions. When these features launch:

  • A separate and updated set of financial terms will apply.
  • KYC (Know Your Customer) verification may be required for withdrawals.
  • Minimum and maximum wager limits will be clearly disclosed.
  • All transactions will be processed on the Polygon blockchain network.
  • Tax obligations arising from winnings are the sole responsibility of the user.
P2E features are not yet active. Any current display of potential earnings is illustrative only.
SECTION 8

Intellectual Property

All content on WordRace.io — including but not limited to the game mechanics, name, logo, design, code, graphics, and text — is the exclusive property of WordRace.io and its creators, protected by copyright and intellectual property laws.

You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to access and use the Platform for personal, non-commercial purposes. You may not:

  • Copy, reproduce, or distribute any Platform content without prior written permission.
  • Reverse engineer, decompile, or extract the Platform's source code.
  • Create derivative works based on Platform content.
SECTION 9

Privacy & Data

Beta Phase

During the current beta phase, no personal data is stored on our servers. All account information, game history, and preferences are stored exclusively in your browser's localStorage.

We do not collect, process, or share personal data at this stage.

Future Privacy Policy

When server-side accounts and P2E features launch, a comprehensive Privacy Policy (compliant with GDPR and applicable data protection laws) will be published and will govern how we handle your personal data.

By continuing to use the Platform after the launch of server-side features, you consent to the updated Privacy Policy.

SECTION 10

Disclaimers & Limitation of Liability

WordRace.io is provided "as is" and "as available" during the beta phase, without warranty of any kind, express or implied.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, WordRace.io and its operators shall not be liable for:

  • Loss of data due to browser cache clearing or device changes.
  • Interruptions, bugs, or errors in the Platform.
  • Any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the Platform.
  • Actions of third parties, including other players.

Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you to the Platform in the 30 days preceding the claim, or $10 USD, whichever is greater.

SECTION 11

Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

For significant changes affecting P2E features or financial terms, we will provide at least 14 days' notice via the Platform or registered email.

SECTION 12

Contact

For questions, concerns, or disputes regarding these Terms, please contact us:

  • 📧 Via the Support page on WordRace.io
  • 🎫 Open a ticket with category "Other" for legal inquiries

We aim to respond within 48 hours on business days (Monday–Friday).
